eligibility_evidence: As a leading provider of Risk Management solutions in the EMEA market, Prometeia is looking to strengthen its International Delivery Team by hiring a Senior IT Delivery Consultant .
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) is the largest of Prometeia's business areas and is the cornerstone of Prometeia’s reputation in the international market.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES : Delivery of credit decision management solutions for the domestic and international banks Drive the implementation (database level customization), integration (batch/web service), release management and production support activities.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Participate in technical analysis activities with Consultants to design and implement most feasible solution Maintain the continuous improvement of delivery processes Support testing activities for the solutions released in accordance with the requirements Work closely with product development team to report needs encountered during projects and help define product roadmaps EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE : Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, Mathematics Engineering or relevant departments At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT delivery Excellent command of English Banking sector experience especially in credit processes will be a plus. REQUIREMENTS : Microsoft SQL Server DB Engine version 2019 and / or later and related SQL language.
